patterns: APPSC asks bare facts: date of first Pokhran test (May 1974), nuclear-bomb trigger (Krytron).
Other PSCs: code names (Smiling Buddha, Operation Shakti), Pokhran-II date 11 May 1998, Pokhran in Rajasthan, doctrine contents (NFU, moratorium, credible minimum deterrence).
Regime questions: India not NPT signatory because discriminatory; joined HCoC; recognised NPT nuclear states.
App is heavily current-affairs and technical (Arihant-class tonnage, BMD tiers, Project Kusha) - well above APPSC PYQ depth but mostly sound.
